items.title: Police Underground Base
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Welcome to the biggest, most top secret and advanced police station ever, secured deep underground. Meet your fellow cops and help guard a prison filled with robbers.
Get ready to become a true police officer--your duty begins today!

+ 9 powerful police vehicles
+ Wearable gear & custom weapons
+ Custom furniture & textures
+ Interactive cops & robbers
+ 8 HD skins

items.title: Snow Monsters
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Stand up strong and mighty in any blizzard with Snow Monsters skins. In icy blue fur and scary horns, role-play with friends as giant Bigfoot creatures. Show off sharp ferocious teeth and evil eyes. Become frightening yetis ready to strike terror in below zero weather!

+ 8 frigid beast HD skins

items.title: Blackstone Camo
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Look like building blocks from the Nether when you gear up in Blackstone Camo skins. Role-play with friends in awesome disguises that may help you blend into the background. Pretend to be dark-colored blocks from underground with silly faces and smiles. Dress up in gilded blackstone and cobbled deepslate textures too.

+ 8 crafty camouflage HD skins

items.title: Neon Glitches
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Rub your eyes and take another look. You’ll be blindingly brilliant and maybe a little buggy in Neon Glitches skins. Role-play with friends and walk around the city in colorful electric green, blue, and pink. Although not perfect, you will glow and glimmer in very vivid outfits. If you malfunction, just keep going, shining bright!

+ 8 fluorescent flawed HD skins

items.title: Stealing Preston's Diamonds 2
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
7 NEW extreme ways to steal PrestonPlayz diamonds! You've seen Preston steal diamonds on YouTube, now steal from his 7 secret diamond bases! Use 7 unique gadgets like dinosaurs, dragons, and bulldozers! Spend your diamond loot to bring the gadgets into survival!

- 7 secure bases to steal from
- 10 epic items to buy
- Connected to survival

By CinemaCraft and Preston

items.title: PrestonPlayz Diamond Teens
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Glimmer with Preston and his diamond teen skins! A wide variety of skins from merch, fancy outfits, fake armor, and memes. Shine bright like a diamond today!

- 2 free skins
- 22 total skins

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: Pure Nether
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Camouflage has been taken to the next level in this skin pack of Nether-inspired textures! Forget being the same old pirate or knight, now you can blend into the darkest corners of the Nether in the form of magma, obsidian, or soul sand!

- Includes 8 skins
- Sneaking around the Nether has never been easier!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Troll Toons
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
What better way to show how you feel than through emojis? In fact, we took it a step further and threw some of the most popular emojis and troll faces into this skin pack of the derpiest and quirkiest looking bunch of characters!

- Includes a massive 24 skins
- Not only is there an outfit for every occasion, but a facial expression too!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Epic Showdown
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
It's time to show the world you're not the noob they think you are!

- 101 Challenges
- Epic Boss Fights
- Survive Deadly Scenarios
- Insane Parkour
- Challenging Mazes
- Find the Button
- Time Trial
- Unlock the Final Battle in the Library
- Versus Mode (Choose which battles your friends must face!)

items.title: Pure Coral
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Now you can be one with the warm ocean biome and live among the inhabitants of coral reefs with this pack of themed skins! You won't need a Silk Touch pickaxe to craft this look, and you won't have to worry about turning into dead coral on land either!

- Includes 10 skins
- Dead coral options are included!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Fancy Shadows
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These shadows are fancy, they wear masks and other fine clothing. Perfect skins for roleplaying in various games or for simply looking sinister. Join the dark side for some yummy cookies!

+ By The Lucky Petals

items.title: Blingy Demons
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Welcome to the world of demons! Luxurious life, fast cars, modern mansions are the reality in which these teenagers live. Put on the latest fashion trends and impress your friends with an exclusive outfit. 
A group of cool demons are waiting for you and are ready to have fun! Join them and become the most popular in the city!

- 1 free skin
- Anime demons

items.title: Sci-Fi Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These astronaut mobs are exploring alien planets! Equipped with the latest tech in space exploration technology, they're ready for anything!

- 8 space suit skins!

This set includes:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Drowned
- Skeleton
- Spider
- Zombie
- Slime
- Bee

items.title: Pajama Jam Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Some of the best times happen at sleepovers! Grab your pajamas and get ready to jam with some friends! Good times are ahead!

+ 20 roleplay skins!
+ Cute and casual attire inspired by fun and beautiful sleep!

items.title: Hot Pink
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
It's hot this year. Something is cooking up the heat! It can only be one thing. It's Hot Pink!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cute and casual attire inspired by pink!

items.title: Anime Style 2
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Have you ever felt like an anime character? Anime Style 2 is the perfect skin pack for you with many different cute skins to choose from! Whether you’re going to roleplay in a Japanese high school setting, or if you simply want to look awesome in singleplayer, this skin pack has an outfit that perfectly matches your personality!

+ 12 cute anime skins!
+ Perfect for teens!

items.title: Skyblock Lazy Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: Your own millionaire mansion awaits in the sky! Make this world your own! Build your new world into a place of your dreams!

items.title: Social Media Influencers
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to become one with your internet idol? Well, now you can! Choose your character and get into the role of your favorite social media dancer, Youtuber, or streamer. Grow your fanbase and become an absolute superstar!

+ 1 FREE skin included
+ 12 celebrity skins
+ Perfect for role-playing

items.title: Civil Heroes
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The superheroes of the daily world, from police officers, to doctors, to firefighters! Become a hero by putting on the uniforms of these civil servants!

+ 12 Prolific Professions
+ Simplistic, aesthetic design!
By thiccsnail

items.title: Cosmic Crew
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Blast off with the Cosmic Crew! You're sure to reach new heights with the help of these 10 galactic skins!

- 10 stylish space cadets
- Clean, cosmic appeal
- By thiccsnail

items.title: Millionaires Winter Resort
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
This resort is perfect for a luxury vacation! Grab your friends and relax in these beautiful snowy mansions.

- Can you find the secret room and the hidden chests?
- Perfect for starting your survival adventure
- Furnished in detail
- 3 snow villages nearby
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Virtual Assistants
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
What would happen if robots and software joined the game as playable skins? These skins are robotic workers and artificial intelligence which became playable. Claim them as yours and join the game!

+ Sci Fi
+ Futuristic
+ AI
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Teens Crowns
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
This skin pack brings fashionable and crowned teens. Grab them all and be the cutest teen in the town. They have unique and modern fashion looks.

+ Anime
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Steampunk Guys
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
These guys had come to us from a world of steam power and steam machines. They are scientists, adventurers and explorers. Dressed like victorian age aristocracy these travellers are yours to command!

+ Anime
+ Steampunk
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine
